title: CityBuildCore
description:
CityBuildCore Plugin
CityBuildCore is an all-in-one Minecraft plugin for Citybuild servers (1.21.11)
body:
🌆 CITYBUILDCORE
The all-in-one engine for serious CityBuild servers

One plugin. Zero bloat. Built for Paper & Purpur 1.21.11.

────────────────────────────

💰 ECONOMY
A real in-game economy — mine, chop, earn. Per-block rewards, anti-farm cooldowns, and instant player-to-player payments.

🏠 HOMES & SPAWN
Multiple homes, permission-based limits, instant teleports. No wasted walking.

🛡️ CHUNK CLAIMS
Buy land, lock it down. Configurable costs, claim limits, full protection.

🏗️ PLOT SYSTEM
Auto-generated plot world with clean roads & grass plots. Auto-find, trust friends, manage everything from a GUI.

🏪 AUCTION HOUSE
A persistent player market. List, search, filter, buy — survives restarts, no losses.

📦 VAULTS
Private, persistent storage for every player. Staff override for support tickets.

🌍 WORLD MANAGEMENT
Farm world + plot world, generated and managed automatically. Random teleport included.

🔨 MODERATION
Tempbans, timeouts, maintenance mode with whitelist + custom MOTD. Everything staff needs, nothing they don't.

📊 SIDEBAR & BROADCASTS
Live scoreboard — balance, plots, claims, playtime. Rotating broadcasts & title messages keep players in the loop.

🎮 GUI MENU
One menu. Every system. No command memorization required.

────────────────────────────

📋 COMMAND REFERENCE

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/money` | Check your balance | `citybuildcore.money` |
| `/pay <player> <amount>` | Send money to a player | `citybuildcore.pay` |
| `/sethome <name>` | Set a home | `citybuildcore.home.set` |
| `/home <name>` | Teleport to a home | `citybuildcore.home.use` |
| `/delhome <name>` | Delete a home | `citybuildcore.home.delete` |
| `/setspawn` | Set the server spawn | `citybuildcore.spawn.set` |
| `/spawn` | Teleport to spawn | `citybuildcore.spawn.use` |
| `/claim` | Claim the current chunk | `citybuildcore.claim` |
| `/unclaim` | Release a claimed chunk | `citybuildcore.unclaim` |
| `/claims` | List your claims | `citybuildcore.claims` |
| `/plot auto` | Auto-find a free plot | `citybuildcore.plot.auto` |
| `/plot claim` | Claim the current plot | `citybuildcore.plot.claim` |
| `/plot home` | Teleport to your plot | `citybuildcore.plot.home` |
| `/plot trust <player>` | Grant build access | `citybuildcore.plot.trust` |
| `/plot untrust <player>` | Revoke build access | `citybuildcore.plot.untrust` |
| `/plot info` | View plot info | `citybuildcore.plot.info` |
| `/plot delete` | Delete your plot | `citybuildcore.plot.delete` |
| `/plot` / `/plots` | Open the plot menu | `citybuildcore.plot` |
| `/ah` | Open the auction house | `citybuildcore.ah` |
| `/ah sell <price>` | List an item for sale | `citybuildcore.ah.sell` |
| `/vault` | Open your vault | `citybuildcore.vault` |
| `/vault <player>` | Open a player's vault (staff) | `citybuildcore.vault.others` |
| `/farmwelt` | Teleport to the farm world | `citybuildcore.world.farm` |
| `/plotwelt` | Teleport to the plot world | `citybuildcore.world.plot` |
| `/rtp` | Random teleport | `citybuildcore.rtp` |
| `/tempban <player> <duration> <reason>` | Temporarily ban a player | `citybuildcore.tempban` |
| `/pardon <player>` | Remove a ban | `citybuildcore.pardon` |
| `/timeout <player> <duration>` | Mute a player | `citybuildcore.timeout` |
| `/untimeout <player>` | Remove a mute | `citybuildcore.untimeout` |
| `/maintenance on/off` | Toggle maintenance mode | `citybuildcore.maintenance` |
| `/broadcast <message>` | Send a server-wide message | `citybuildcore.broadcast` |
| `/gui` | Open the main GUI menu | `citybuildcore.gui` |

Duration formats: `30m` `2h` `12h` `7d` `30d`
